jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Company Description Lance is revolutionizing the hospitality industry with autonomous AI agents that handle tasks such as answering calls, closing sales, and managing operations, enabling teams to focus on guests. Trusted by leading hotel groups in the United States, Lance supports over 50 hotels, including renowned brands like Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt. Built on advanced Computer Use Agent technology, Lance's AI agents integrate seamlessly with hotel software, make real-time decisions, and execute complex multi-step tasks efficiently. By automating operational workflows, Lance empowers hotels to deliver enhanced guest experiences. Role Description The Product Marketing Manager will develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new product features and launches, crafting clear and compelling messaging that differentiates Lance in the hospitality and AI markets. A key aspect of the role will be managing third-party vendors, including videographers and creative partners, to produce high-quality marketing content that aligns with Lance’s brand and go-to-market strategy. This role involves close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams to deeply understand product capabilities and the roadmap, while enabling Sales and Solutions teams with effective pitch decks, demos, case studies, and objection-handling materials. The Product Marketing Manager will conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and refine positioning, as well as gather and synthesize customer insights to inform both marketing strategy and product development. Additionally, the role includes driving content creation across website, email, and outbound channels to support demand generation, and continuously measuring and optimizing campaign performance, messaging effectiveness, and product adoption. Qualifications - Work 996 In-Person San Francisco - Experience in Product Marketing, Growth, or related roles in B2B SaaS or AI companies - Strong ability to translate technical products (AI, automation, or software platforms) into clear business value - Proven track record of executing successful go-to-market strategies and product launches - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience creating sales and marketing collateral - Analytical mindset with experience in market research, customer insights, and performance tracking - Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Operations teams - Strong ownership mentality and comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment - Familiarity with hospitality, travel technology, or vertical SaaS is a plus - Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field Total Compensation $140,000 Cash + Equity + Bonus Monthly Health and Wellness Stipend Complimentary In Office Meals

jobs.title: Founding Product Designer (UI/UX)
jobs.description: About Lance Lance (YC W26) builds autonomous AI agents that run hotel operations end-to-end, from answering guest calls to managing workflows across systems. We work with leading hotel groups across brands like Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt, and are already deployed across 50+ properties in the U.S. Our agents don’t just assist, they execute. They integrate directly into existing hotel systems, make real-time decisions, and handle complex, multi-step operations. Role Overview We’re hiring our Founding Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience of our AI agents and the platforms our customers use to interact with them. You will be responsible for establishing Lance’s design language from the ground up, translating complex AI workflows into intuitive, elegant interfaces. This is a high-ownership role for a product-minded designer who wants to define the look, feel, and function of a category-defining product. What You’ll Do - Own the entire design process, from concept and wireframing to high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes. - Translate complex user needs and product requirements into beautiful, intuitive, and functional user interfaces. - Work directly with the founders, product managers, and engineers to define both the long-term design vision and the short-term tactical execution. - Establish and own Lance’s design system, ensuring a consistent and high-quality user experience across all platforms. - Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and advocate for the user. - Collaborate closely with engineering to bridge the gap between design and front-end implementation, ensuring pixel-perfect execution. What We’re Looking For - A world-class portfolio showcasing your expertise in UI/UX, visual design, and product thinking is required. Please provide a link to your portfolio in your application. - Experience in product design, with a focus on complex B2B SaaS or enterprise applications. - Deep expertise in modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma). - A strong understanding of user-centered design principles and a passion for solving complex problems. - High ownership and a bias for action; you are comfortable moving fast and creating structure where it doesn’t exist. - Excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate your design decisions. - Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React) is a major plus. Why This Role - Define the design culture and principles from day one. - High ownership over the entire product experience. - Work directly with the founders on core product decisions. - Build a real, impactful system, not just decks. Total Compensation $100,000 - $160,000 Cash, Equity, Bonus

raw.title: Founding Product Designer (UI/UX)
raw.descriptionHtml:
About Lance
Lance (YC W26) builds autonomous AI agents that run hotel operations end-to-end, from answering guest calls to managing workflows across systems. We work with leading hotel groups across brands like Marriott, Hilton, and Hyatt, and are already deployed across 50+ properties in the U.S.

Our agents don’t just assist, they execute. They integrate directly into existing hotel systems, make real-time decisions, and handle complex, multi-step operations.

Role Overview
We’re hiring our Founding Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience of our AI agents and the platforms our customers use to interact with them. You will be responsible for establishing Lance’s design language from the ground up, translating complex AI workflows into intuitive, elegant interfaces.

This is a high-ownership role for a product-minded designer who wants to define the look, feel, and function of a category-defining product.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the entire design process, from concept and wireframing to high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.

  • Translate complex user needs and product requirements into beautiful, intuitive, and functional user interfaces.

  • Work directly with the founders, product managers, and engineers to define both the long-term design vision and the short-term tactical execution.

  • Establish and own Lance’s design system, ensuring a consistent and high-quality user experience across all platforms.

  • Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and advocate for the user.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering to bridge the gap between design and front-end implementation, ensuring pixel-perfect execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A world-class portfolio showcasing your expertise in UI/UX, visual design, and product thinking is required. Please provide a link to your portfolio in your application.

  • Experience in product design, with a focus on complex B2B SaaS or enterprise applications.

  • Deep expertise in modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma).

  • A strong understanding of user-centered design principles and a passion for solving complex problems.

  • High ownership and a bias for action; you are comfortable moving fast and creating structure where it doesn’t exist.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate your design decisions.

  • Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React) is a major plus.

Why This Role

  • Define the design culture and principles from day one.

  • High ownership over the entire product experience.

  • Work directly with the founders on core product decisions.

  • Build a real, impactful system, not just decks.

Total Compensation
$100,000 - $160,000 Cash, Equity, Bonus

Role Overview We’re hiring our Founding Account Executive to build and own our sales function from the ground up. You will be responsible for driving our early revenue growth, closing deals with leading hotel groups, and creating the playbook that will define our sales motion for years to come. This is a high-intensity, execution-driven role for a hungry, entrepreneurial sales professional who wants to build a revenue machine, not just run a territory. Why This Role - Build the sales organization and culture from the ground up. - Uncapped earning potential through direct, measurable impact on company revenue. - Work directly with the founders to shape the go-to-market strategy. - Define the sales playbook, not just execute a pre-written one. Total Compensation $100,000 - $160,000 Cash, Equity, Bonus
